correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the explicit two-center tree T_m, with each center carrying m pendant edges and m length-two arms; |V(T)|=6m+2 and |V(L(T))|=6m+1. In its line graph the four degree-determined classes b,U,V,Z of sizes 1,2m,2m,2m have degrees 4m,2m,2m+1,1, respectively, and common equitable quotient rows (0,2m,2m,0), (1,m−1,m,0), (1,m,m−1,1), (0,0,1,0). Deleting uA1–vA1 and uB1–vB1 and inserting crossed uA1–vB1, uB1–vA1 preserves each class-to-class degree and therefore all ordinary color-refinement rounds, equivalently C² equivalence. The original line graph has precisely 2*C(2m+1,3) triangles. Two within-center removals lose 2(2m−1) triangles; each crossed edge gains one through central b, so the deficit is 4m−4>0 for all m≥2. Independently built the graphs and checked equitable quotient and triangle counts for m=2,3,5. The proof for every m is the symbolic quotient/triangle argument, not finite experiments.

originality.rationale: PASS for the precise infinite two-edge-switched line-tree family and unbounded triangle deficit, though the general fact that line graphs need not preserve refinement-related properties is not entirely new. The 2015 Arvind–Köbler–Rattan–Verbitsky result proves that forests are amenable but does not construct this all-m line-graph twin family. An October 18 Resultary classification already gives a *single* nine-vertex tree whose line graph is non-orbit-refinable, so the qualitative line-graph closure obstruction can be inferred with further standard implications. That prior is a different orbit-equivalence assertion and does not state or imply this family of jointly refinement-equivalent nonisomorphic graphs with exact 4m−4 triangle gap. This limited novelty scope is explicit.
residual_risks: Known orbit-refinement obstruction can already establish general non-preservation of amenability by line graphs under standard implications; do not advertise the qualitative closure failure alone as new.
An earlier unsurfaced class-preserving 2-switch construction for line graphs or block graphs could subsume the infinite family.
Does not claim that comparison H_m is itself a line graph of a tree or that 14-vertex base tree is minimal.
